integrity: Exact non-asymptotic covariance formula, dyadic-arc proof and independently executable exact tests are supplied. Finite testing is corroboration, not a proof of the all-index statement.
scientific_limitations: The method uses the established all-index quartic-integral valuation identity; it does not reprove that identity. The originality comparison is based on inspected primary papers, targeted mathematical search and the accessible prior-record claims, and does not establish historical priority or independence.
title: Universal sharp dyadic anticorrelation for quartic-integral valuations
